profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MoneyDolly

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Create enhancements for a Python-based chatbot with natural language processing used by job seekers to find and apply for jobs, schedule interviews, complete assessments, and receive job offers. Projects include: implementing geospatial searches to improve job results, improving ATS and calendar integrations, implement internationalization, and writing/tuning Django, MySQL, and PostgreSQL queries to optimize performance.

• Add features to the ReactJs web application used by recruiters and hiring managers to manage candidates and jobs including a bulk user management feature and converting UI components to the Material UI.

• Update an Apache NiFi pipeline to import data from multiple data sources into Snowflake. Created Snowflake tables, views, and queries to support Tableau and in-app reporting for the web application.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · MySQL · docker · JavaScript · React.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Jenkins · Snowflake · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · Linux

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an e-signature, document storage, and e- payment platform including backend services (C#.Net), cloud based integrations (AWS, Azure), database backend (SQLServer), and VueJS front end.

• Created and developed a greenfield web application (C#.Net, SQLServer, ExtJs) to re-invent the core business desktop application.

• Developed responsive front end for all form factors and devices including mobile, tablet, and desktop. Created complex, event driven, multi-step, workflow integrations with third parties including insurance companies, payment processors, and website vendors.
positions.insights: Skills: TeamCity · C# · Microsoft Azure · Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ext JS · Azure DevOps Server · .NET Framework · Vue.js · Octopus Products · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · Database Design · Internet Information Services (IIS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, National Airways Systems Engineering
positions.description:
• Implemented updates to the Tower Data Link Services to help air traffic controllers better manage ground traffic at all US airports (C++).

• Created tools to analyze system performance and identify areas for improvement (Ruby).

• Analyzed and improved low performance database queries, added indexing, and created designs to improve database performance (MySQL).
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · MySQL · C (Programming Language) · Jenkins · Ruby · Linux

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed applications and services for a large-scale human-in-the- loop simulation of the National Airspace System for research and development of proposed flight procedures and training of air traffic controllers including: radar applications for tower, TRACON and enroute, back end simulations for radars and the flight plan system, companion pilot applications for ground and air (C++, PostgreSQL).

• Designed and developed a full stack web application to create, manage, and analyze the real-time simulation (NodeJS, ExtJS, PostgreSQL). Created a gamified, tablet based platform tied in to the real-time simulation for air traffic control trainees to practice controlling.

• Developed applications to analyze and visualize risk of terrain and surface obstacle collisions on take off and landing.

• Interviewed, trained, and mentored junior developers.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Node.js · WebSocket · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · Ext JS · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · User Interface Design · Database Design · Distributed Systems · Flight Simulation · Modeling and Simulation

positions.title: Programmer II
positions.description: Created UI enhancements in a web application used by employers to facilitate enrollment in insurance plans. Analyzed and optimized database queries in the MySQL database. Created ETL applications for data from health insurance providers.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description: Created applications to automate previously manual nightly and monthly processing jobs, reducing the time needed to perform these tasks by over 70%. Created applications to automate phone system procedures. Administered the AIX mainframe, Windows servers, and networks.
positions.insights: Skills: Desktop Administration · IBM AIX · Windows Server · Microsoft Exchange

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description: Created a desktop application for the County including a records management system, County Clerk and property data application for the County Assessor. Provided desktop support and Windows server implementation and maintenance.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Technical Support · Windows Server · Firebird · Windows Software Development

positions.title: Software Developer / DBA
positions.description: Designed, built, and supported a new Windows-based application and Linux-based messaging server to support the tribe's contract health, accounting, and outreach departments.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Firebird · Windows Software Development
